==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I befriend an alien man made of brown slime. He has very long limbs. He is blind in one eye.

We go on a mission in a virtual world. There we have to fight mobsters and their zombie minions using blasts of pink energy. We defeat many of them, but ultimately we have to flee.

I am analyzing an important card on our VR Ship. The card is being used by our enemies to track us. I can't get rid of the card, but I can't figure out how to deactivate the tracking capability.
